[LSER.9.2.1a] **Replay.** Because series state cold-starts and is not
serialised, byte-for-byte replay of a rule that
reads an aggregation requires the recording to have begun at
engine-cold — then every sample re-absorbs from the event trace in
order and the backings rebuild identically. A recording started
against an already-warm engine diverges on series-derived facts. See
[LDET.2.2a].
